prompts.diamond: Use case: productivity-visual. Asset type: production UI paper texture for a DIAMOND-shaped story event node in an elegant Chinese novel-writing flowchart. Generate ONE flat, front-facing, full-bleed rectangular texture sheet, landscape 3:2. This image will be clipped into a diamond by live SVG, so DO NOT draw a diamond, a card outline, border, frame, folded corner, or any object silhouette inside the image. Material: very pale warm ivory pressed cotton rag paper, microscopic short cellulose fibers and subtle soft embossing, like premium uncoated archival stationery. Almost uniform luminance, low contrast; delicate tactile grain discernible at close range, clean enough for dark HTML text over the entire central area. Extremely restrained soft top-left illumination, no vignette. Color family #f6f1e4, complementary to cool white cotton paper and a quiet sage-green writing canvas. No text, numbers, letters, icons, logos, watermark, gold flecks, patterns, external scene, perspective, shadows, or tabletop. Entire bitmap must be filled with paper texture to every edge, no transparency.
